name: Twisting by hand
notes: Rolling fibre into cord between the palms, or down the thigh, with nothing in the hands but the fibre. The oldest making there is, and it needs no tool and no place: it is what a person does with a handful of bast while they wait. Held apart from spinning, which draws thread on a whorl and so wants something that works; a working length of cord does not, and never did.
